description: NASA NDC workstation (36 cores, 251 GB); also the results server
_capabilities_note: valgrind: /usr/bin/valgrind (3.15) is on the PATH of the runners; it enables the memcheck runner
_vars_note: swmf_data is the nightly's own copy: amps_nightly_test.sh resets it to the newest SWMF_data commit each night (tests edit reference files in it). enceladus_shape_manifest is temporary: the file is excluded from git by the .gitignore pattern 'data' (to decide 2026-11-15)
_lanes_note: 4 Makefile.test runs at once (most use 8 MPI ranks): 32 ranks on 36 cores. With 10 lanes (80 ranks) the long tests ran 2-3 times slower and magnetic-reconnection, fast-wave_rebalancing and CG-dust hit the 2-hour limit (2026-11-14/15); OpenMP threads per rank: makefile_runner.OMP_THREADS
_compile_note: 4 Makefile.test tests compile at once, each in its own copy of the workspace (the SWMF tests in the workspace itself); each compile runs make -j<compile_jobs> (TESTCOMPILEJOBS), by default cores / (compile_lanes x max_parallel) = 36 / 4 = 9, so the lanes use the 36 cores. On 2026-11-17 the 89 compiles ran one at a time with make -j8 for 185 of the runner's 255 min. Set "compile_jobs" here (machine) or in a configs entry (one compiler) to change it
